cohort: Women who had singleton live births after embryo-transfer cycles at three fertility centers, categorized by a history of unexplained recurrent implantation failure (uRIF) or fewer than three failed implantation cycles (control).
finding: A history of unexplained recurrent implantation failure (uRIF) was associated with increased risks for placenta previa, placental abruption, Cesarean delivery, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: The uRIF group exhibited significantly higher odds of Cesarean delivery (aOR, 1.27) compared with the control group.
